Pre-Generated content reviewed like other content; Live-Generated content must also describe guardrails against illegal output. Live-generated AI adult-only sexual content not permitted. Lists ways to fund ongoing AI service costs (base price, microtransactions, subscription, DLC).

name: Generative agent-based modeling with actions grounded in physical, social, or digital space using Concordia
authors: Alexander Sasha Vezhnevets;John P. Agapiou;Avia Aharon;Ron Ziv;Jayd Matyas;Edgar A. Duéñez-Guzmán;William A. Cunningham;Simon Osindero;Danny Karmon;Joel Z. Leibo
notes: Agents state intended actions in natural language; a Game Master agent, inspired by tabletop RPGs, decides outcomes, checks physical plausibility, and can call digital tools. Behavior comes from components mediating LLM calls and associative memory retrieval.

name: Multi-Actor Generative Artificial Intelligence as a Game Engine
authors: Alexander Sasha Vezhnevets;Jayd Matyas;Logan Cross;Davide Paglieri;Minsuk Chang;William A. Cunningham;Simon Osindero;William S. Isaac;Joel Z. Leibo
notes: Entity-Component pattern for Concordia: the Game Master is a configurable entity built from components; separates engineers (components) from designers (scenarios). Classifies multi-actor uses as Simulationist, Dramatist, and Evaluationist.

name: Improving Conditional Level Generation using Automated Validation in Match-3 Games
authors: Monica Villanueva Aylagas;Joakim Bergdahl;Jonas Gillberg;Alessandro Sestini;Theodor Tolstoy;Linus Gisslén
notes: EA SEED cVAE conditioned on size, symmetry, and difficulty (median moves of a scripted bot over 30 plays); 51.39% valid levels versus 46.15% in the dataset; difficulty accuracy 33.33%, mean gap 10.19 moves.

name: Fluctuations in the Abundance of a Species considered Mathematically
notes: Volterra's predator-prey equations, independently of Lotka; prey grow and are consumed in proportion to encounters with predators, predators grow from consumption and die at a constant rate, producing persistent oscillations.

name: Paired Open-Ended Trailblazer (POET): Endlessly Generating Increasingly Complex and Diverse Learning Environments and Their Solutions
authors: Rui Wang;Joel Lehman;Jeff Clune;Kenneth O. Stanley

name: Enhanced POET: Open-Ended Reinforcement Learning through Unbounded Invention of Learning Challenges and their Solutions
authors: Rui Wang;Joel Lehman;Aditya Rawal;Jiale Zhi;Yulun Li;Jeff Clune;Kenneth O. Stanley

name: Voyager: An Open-Ended Embodied Agent with Large Language Models
authors: Guanzhi Wang;Yuqi Xie;Yunfan Jiang;Ajay Mandlekar;Chaowei Xiao;Yuke Zhu;Linxi Fan;Anima Anandkumar
notes: Automatic curriculum, skill library of executable code, iterative prompting with environment feedback, execution errors, and self-verification; GPT-4. 3.3x unique items, 2.3x distance, tech-tree milestones up to 15.3x faster; 63 items in 160 iterations; GPT-4 15x cost of GPT-3.5; GPT-3.5 code gen 5.7x fewer items; hallucinated tasks (copper sword) and nonexistent API calls.

name: Can Language Models Serve as Text-Based World Simulators?
authors: Ruoyao Wang;Graham Todd;Ziang Xiao;Xingdi Yuan;Marc-Alexandre Côté;Peter Clark;Peter Jansen
notes: ByteSized32-State-Prediction: 76,369 transitions from 31 text games. GPT-4 whole-state accuracy at most 59.9%; action-driven up to 77.1%; environment-driven at most 49.7%; humans about 80% on a subset where GPT-4 averaged about 50%. Failures in arithmetic, common sense, scientific knowledge.

name: Matrix-Game 3.0: Real-Time and Streaming Interactive World Model with Long-Horizon Memory
notes: 720p up to 40 fps with a 5B model on an 8+1 GPU setup; 2x14B scaled model; camera-aware memory retrieval by pose and field-of-view overlap; minute-long consistency; DMD distillation, quantization, VAE decoder pruning.

name: Biological homeostasis of the global environment: the parable of Daisyworld
notes: Daisyworld model: black and white daisies with different albedo regulate planetary temperature across a range of stellar luminosity without foresight, illustrating biosphere-climate feedback.

name: A Tale in the Desert
notes: eGenesis; First Telling launched 2003-02-15; later Pluribus Games and Desert Nomad Studios. Windows, Linux, Mac. No combat; Tellings average about 18 months and end in a wipe; seven tests per discipline leading to Oracle rank and Monuments; laws by petition with signatures then a vote, a controlled variant of Nomic; elected Demi-Pharaoh can ban up to seven characters; no official currency; gathering wood, mining, flax.

name: Against the Storm (video game)
notes: Eremite Games, Hooded Horse; early access October 2021; Windows 2023-12-08; consoles 2025-06-26; each run is a short settlement map; Reputation gauge versus Queen's Impatience; seven species, three per village; villagers leave when discontented; blight and corruption; seal fragments; storm destroys settlements and a new map is generated; over a million Steam copies by May 2024.

name: AI Dungeon
notes: Latitude; 2019 release, AI Dungeon 2 in December 2019 on GPT-2 (1.5B), GPT-3 from July 2020; Do, Say, Story, See inputs; player-set memory; criticism of forgetting earlier content; 2021 moderation filter with false positives.

name: Animal Crossing
notes: Series uses the console's internal clock and calendar so game time matches real time; some events and tree growth require real time to pass; hourly music; original Dobutsu no Mori on Nintendo 64, 14 April 2001.

name: Animal Crossing: New Horizons
notes: Nintendo EPD, Switch release 2020-03-20, Switch 2 edition 2026-01-15; real-time clock with hemisphere seasons, D.I.Y. crafting, Nook Miles, museum, island rating, Island Designer, reduced bank interest to deter time travel, 4 local and 8 online players.

name: Anno 117: Pax Romana
notes: Ubisoft Mainz, Ubisoft; PS5, Windows, Xbox Series 2025-11-13; Latium or Albion starts; tiers from Liberti to Patricians; optional categorized needs; goods attributes; adjacency effects of production buildings; diagonal placement; paved roads extend range; belief and gods; schools generate research for 100+ unlocks; modular ships; co-op; mod loader at launch.

name: Anno 1800
notes: Ubisoft Blue Byte, Ubisoft; Windows 2019-04-16; Console Edition PS5 and Xbox Series 2023-03-16; Old World and New World sessions linked by trade routes; citizen needs drive production chains; AI rivals on the same map; naval warfare; attractiveness and tourism lowered by factories and pollution; blueprint mode; multiplayer.

name: ARC Raiders
notes: Released 2025-10-30 by Embark Studios; AI text-to-speech voice lines criticized and debated; 4M copies by 2025-11-11, 14M by 2026-02; Embark CEO said in 2026-03 some AI voice lines were re-recorded by human actors.

name: Arma 3
notes: Bohemia Interactive. Alpha 2013-03-05 on Steam Early Access, full release 2013-09-12 (Windows); macOS and Linux 2015. Weapons affected by external ballistics and recoil; carried weight reduces speed and stamina; combat vehicles, helicopters, jets, boats, diving; Eden 3D editor (2016); SQF scripting; Steam Workshop modding; terrains Tanoa 100 km2, Malden 57 km2, Livonia 163 km2; military consultants wrote after-action reports for Tac-Ops.

name: Artificial intelligence in video games
notes: Steam requires disclosure of pre-generated and live-generated AI content (January 2024). ARC Raiders (Nov 2025) criticized and marked down by Eurogamer for generative AI NPC voices. SAG-AFTRA video game strike July 2024 to July 2025 ended with AI voice consent terms. Players criticized apparently AI-generated dialogue in Where Winds Meet. Infinite Craft uses LLaMA.

name: Autonauts (Denki article)
notes: Covered in the article on Denki (Dundee, founded 2000 by former DMA Design staff): Autonauts public demo on itch.io 2017-07-05; Steam PC release October 2019 published by Curve Digital; Autonauts vs. Piratebots released 2022-07-28.

name: Balance of Power (video game)
notes: Chris Crawford, Mindscape; Macintosh 1985 (infobox November, body September); ports to MS-DOS, Amiga, Atari ST, Apple II, PC-88, PC-98, MSX, Windows. Player leads US or USSR for eight one-year turns, maximizes prestige points, answers crises with no action, diplomatic notes, or military maneuvers; backing down costs prestige; escalation can trigger nuclear war, which ends the game. Compared with Ketchledge's Geopolitique 1990.

name: Banished (video game)
notes: Shining Rock Software, Luke Hodorowicz; Windows 2014-02-18; citizens are the primary resource; workplace assignment; aging, births, nomads; fire and starvation hazards; mod support from patch 1.04 (November 2014); Anno series cited as a big inspiration, combat left out.

name: BeamNG.drive
notes: BeamNG GmbH; tech demo and paid alpha 2013-08-03, Steam Early Access 2015-05-29; JBeam node-and-beam soft-body vehicles; damage to engines, doors, windows, tires, fuel tanks; free roam, campaigns, time trials; Lua mods via official repository; BeamNG.tech research fork; PS5 version scheduled for 2026-10-19 with version 0.40.

name: Besiege (video game)
notes: Spiderling Studios; early access 2015-01-28; full release 2020-02-18; PC, Xbox, PlayStation, Switch, mobile (2025); 55 campaign levels on four islands; logic blocks (timers, gates, sensors); PC multiplayer and level editor added December 2017; Splintered Sea expansion adds water physics.

name: Big Pharma (video game)
notes: Twice Circled, Tim Wicksteed, Positech Games, 2015-08-27 PC; Xbox One, Switch, PS4 2019. Ingredient effects active in concentration windows on a 0-20 scale; machines and conveyor belts; letter grade from effectiveness, side effects, demand; market saturation by rivals; research tree; explorers find ingredients.

name: Black & White (video game)
notes: Lionhead Studios, released 2001-03-27; worshipping villagers generate power for miracles; miracles selected at the Temple or Village Centre or cast by gestures with the Hand; the creature learns from responses to its actions.

name: Caesar III
notes: Released 1998-09-30 by Impressions Games; inhabitants provide services to buildings by walking past them, adding strategy to road pathing.

name: Cai Haoyu
notes: Formed the California-based startup Anuttacon in late 2023; Whispers from the Star announced in 2025 as its first game.

name: Capitalism (video game)
notes: 1995, Enlight, Trevor Chan; rivals with adjustable competence and managerial style; buyout threat; optional stock market; R&D raises product quality.

name: Car Mechanic Simulator 2018
notes: Red Dot Games; players examine engine, suspension, and chassis, remove parts in a realistic order to reach damaged ones, buy or repair parts, test track for brake and suspension problems; sequel Car Mechanic Simulator 2021 released 2021-08-11.

name: Cities: Skylines
notes: Colossal Order, Paradox Interactive; Windows, macOS, Linux 2015-03-10; Xbox One and PS4 2017, Switch 2018; zoning grid follows roads; districts and policies; power, water, sewage; citizens take the fastest route; buses, trams, trains, ferries, metro; population milestones unlock services and up to 25 map tiles; Steam Workshop; Cities in Motion lineage; approved after SimCity (2013) reception.

name: Cities: Skylines II
notes: Windows 2023-10-24; Colossal Order until a November 2025 handover, Iceflake Studios from 2026; console versions delayed indefinitely in July 2024 with no date as of late 2026; route choice by length, cost, comfort, preference; 9 to 441 map tiles; development points tech tree; preset climates and seasons; one day-night cycle equals one month; Paradox Mods from 2024-03-25.

name: City-building game
notes: Genre history: The Sumerian Game adapted into The Sumer Game (Hamurabi); Utopia as the first sim game; genre established in 1989 with SimCity; Caesar began the Impressions historical series; Banished kick-started the survival city-builder trend; Cities: Skylines revived the SimCity style.

name: Civilization (video game)
notes: MicroProse, September 1991; Sid Meier and Bruce Shelley. MS-DOS, Amiga, Atari ST, PC-98, Windows, Macintosh, SNES, PlayStation, Saturn. Turn-based 4X from 4000 BC to AD 2100 against two to seven AI civs; one advance researched at a time; one-per-world wonders; barbarians; conquest or space-race victory. Influences: Tresham's Civilization board game, Empire, SimCity, Railroad Tycoon, Populous.

name: Command: Modern Operations
notes: Warfare Sims, Matrix Games; operational control of units on a map of Earth; missions or direct orders; scenarios hours to days with time acceleration; DB3000 and Cold War platform databases; Professional Edition with database editing and Monte Carlo analysis (article release date 2013 refers to the predecessor Command: Modern Air/Naval Operations).

name: Contraband Police
notes: Crazy Rocks Studios, PlayWay, Unity; Windows March 2023, PS5 and Xbox Series 2025-11-07; 1981 Acaristan; document checks, contraband search, chases, field missions, border raids; free prologue demo about two years earlier.

name: Conway's Game of Life
notes: Devised by John Horton Conway; first published in Martin Gardner's Scientific American column, October 1970; B3/S23 rule, simultaneous update, zero-player; Turing complete; R-pentomino 1,103 generations; Gosper glider gun (November 1970, period 30); first interactive program on a PDP-7; Golly with Hashlife and Lua or Python scripting.

name: Corrupted Blood incident
notes: World of Warcraft, 13 September to 8 October 2005; Hakkar's Corrupted Blood debuff (263-337 damage every two seconds, spreads to nearby characters, no immunity) escaped Zul'Gurub via suspended pets and fast travel to cities; quarantines partly bypassed; servers hard-reset after about a week; pets made immune on 8 October.

name: Creatures (1996 video game)
notes: Windows and Mac release EU November 1996, NA July 1997; PlayStation 2001-2002; Game Boy Advance 2002; Norns learn through neural networks; every copy shipped a unique starting set of egg genomes; Grendels; Life Kit expansion; sales near 400,000 by February 1998.

name: Creatures (video game series)
notes: Created by Steve Grand at Millennium Interactive; haploid genetics with no dominance and no recombination between loci; simulated biochemistry and organs; neural-network brain with one sight neuron group per object type; drive-reduction learning; word teaching and typed instructions; lifespan about 40 hours; Grendels carry disease; online Norn-swapping community.

name: Crusader Kings III
notes: Paradox Development Studio, Paradox Interactive. PC 2020-09-01; PS5 and Xbox Series 2022-03-29. Start dates 867, 1066, 1178; ends 1453. Play continues with the heir on death; game ends without a viable heir; dynasty Renown. Six skills; personality, education, and genetic traits; stress from acting against traits can be lethal; six lifestyles with three skill trees each; prestige, gold, piety; levies, men-at-arms, knights.

name: DCS World
notes: Eagle Dynamics study sim; clickable cockpits; engines, fuel, electrical, hydraulic, radios modeled. Black Shark (Ka-50) first of three standalone titles, 2008-2011; DCS World open beta May 2012; free with two aircraft and two maps, paid modules. Lua mission editor; user-hosted PvE and PvP servers. Training use: USAF 355th Training Squadron (A-10C), French Air Force (M-2000C), Ukrainian pilots (A-10C II, F-16C). F-16C: Professional Flight Model, fly-by-wire FCS. 2.7 (April 2021) new weather and clouds; improved damage models over time.

name: Deep Learning Super Sampling
notes: Versions 1.0 (2019) to 4.5 (2026-01) and 5.0 (announced 2026-03, available 2026-09); 540+ DLSS titles 2025-01; 250+ MFG 2026-01; frame generation adds latency and artifacts; DLSS 5 negative reception and reported 50-60% frame-rate cost.

name: Democracy 4
notes: Positech series release dates; neural-network-based logic in CSV files; overlapping voter factions; political capital; two pre-election promises and cynicism; situations; tax evasion at high taxes.

name: Don't Starve
notes: Klei Entertainment; beta 2012, release 2013-04-23 for Windows, OS X, Linux, later PlayStation, Wii U, Xbox One, iOS, Android, Switch; hunger, health, and sanity meters; below 15% sanity figments attack; 8-minute days; Charlie attacks in darkness; spoilage; permadeath except rare items; random worlds; Don't Starve Together.

name: Dwarf Fortress
notes: World generation with midpoint-displacement elevation, rainfall, drainage, temperature, erosion-traced rivers, and rain shadows; history simulated for a player-chosen number of years; Legends mode and XML export; Tarn Adams calls the game a story generator; Steam release 2022-12-06.

name: Dyson Sphere Program
notes: Youthcat Studio, published by Gamera Games; Windows early access 2021-01-21; single-player; drones move resources between factories across a star system; research matrices consumed by labs; Rise of the Dark Fog update (December 2023) added a hostile faction; developers drew inspiration from Stellaris Dyson spheres; 1.7 million sold by September 2021.

name: Eco (2018 video game)
notes: Strange Loop Games; early access 2018-02-06; players form governments and propose and vote on laws that restrict actions or apply taxes and grants; ecosystem damage from overharvest and pollution.

name: Elite (video game)
notes: David Braben and Ian Bell; Acornsoft, BBC Micro, September 1984; eight procedurally generated galaxies from seeds; 7 light-year hyperspace limit by fuel; trading, piracy, bounty hunting, combat rating to Elite; credited with defining space trading genre; lists influenced titles including EVE Online.

name: Elite Dangerous
notes: Frontier Developments; backer alpha December 2013; full release 2014-12-16 (Windows); Xbox One 2015, PS4 2017; VR support; Stellar Forge 1:1 Milky Way of ~400 billion systems; Background Simulation of factions and economies; Powerplay (2015); Solo, Private Group, Open modes; Odyssey 2021.

name: Euro Truck Simulator 2
notes: SCS Software, Prism3D; Windows 2012-10-18, Linux 2013, macOS 2015; timed deliveries with pay reduced by damage; fuel, tolls, repair costs; buy trucks, trailers, garages, hire AI drivers; skill points unlock ADR, fragile, urgent jobs; 71 cities in 12 countries; TruckersMP mod 2013, official multiplayer 2021; over 22 million sold by 2026.

name: Europa Universalis IV
notes: Paradox Development Studio, Paradox Interactive, August 2013 (infobox 13, body 25); Windows, OS X, Linux. Over 500 playable nations, 1444 to 1821, no strict win condition. Administrative, diplomatic, and military monarch power buys technology; institutions spread by province; trade nodes and merchants; alliances, vassals, coalitions; estates; random and historical events; Ironman mode.

name: Eve Online
notes: Single-universe MMO on the Tranquility server, taken offline daily for maintenance; player-driven economy; real-time skill training while offline; corporations with CEO and roles, member taxes, weekly-fee war declarations, alliances claiming null-sec sovereignty; Bloodbath of B-R5RB lasted 21 hours; CCP Games, 2003-05-06.

name: Façade (video game)
notes: Michael Mateas and Andrew Stern, Procedural Arts; free Windows release 2005-07-05, Mac 2006; typed natural language input, A Behavior Language, drama manager, three endings, player can be removed.

name: Factorio
notes: Wube Software (Prague), developed since mid-2012; Indiegogo campaign 2013-01-31 to 2013-03-03; downloadable from the official site early in development; Steam early access 2016-02-25; 1.0 on 2020-08-14; Space Age expansion 2024-10-21; Nintendo Switch 2022-10-28; co-op and competitive multiplayer; Lua mods via mod portal; lead designer Michal Kovarik cited the Minecraft mods IndustrialCraft and BuildCraft; 3.5 million sold by December 2022.

name: Farming Simulator
notes: Series article: FS25 released 2024-11-12; dynamically generated missions, seasonal cycle and production chains since FS22, multiplayer since FS2013, modding since FS2009, PC and console platforms.

name: Farthest Frontier
notes: Crate Entertainment; early access 2022-08-09; 1.0 on 2025-10-23; Windows; soil fertility, crop rotation, rock and weed removal; cholera, scurvy, dysentery, bubonic plague; varied diets; raiders and wildlife; walls, towers, barracks.

name: FIFA 22
notes: HyperMotion: 22 players in mocap suits for a full match; ML algorithm using over 8.7 million frames of match capture generates animation in real time; PS5, Xbox Series X/S, Stadia only.

name: Fog of war
notes: Video game section: Walter Bright's Empire (1977) credited as earliest use; Tanktics (1978); Warcraft and StarCraft reveal through reconnaissance with previously seen areas keeping terrain but not unit changes; AI given full map knowledge seen as cheating.

name: Football Manager
notes: Series article: Sports Interactive, Sega; relaunch after the Eidos split; platforms PC, mobile, PSP, Xbox 360, Switch; researcher database; scout knowledge; 2D engine 2005, 3D engine 2009; tactics, transfers, finances, board, press conferences; Everton use of the database 2008.

name: Football Manager 2005
notes: First Football Manager, released in Europe 2004-11-04/05; built on Championship Manager 4 code; Windows and Mac OS X; single player plus TCP/IP and hot-seat multiplayer; board judges performance.

name: Foundation (video game)
notes: Polymorph Games; early access 2019-02-01; full release 2025-01-31; Windows; gridless organic placement; trade with neighboring villages; villagers assigned to jobs; progression through tiers guided by a book.

name: From Dust
notes: Ubisoft Montpellier, designed by Eric Chahi; Xbox Live Arcade 2011-07-27, Windows 2011-08-17, PSN 2011-09, Chrome 2012-05-23; lava cools to rock, water erodes, vegetation spreads; the Breath cursor; totems and villages; tsunami and eruption warnings; spiritual successor to Populous.

name: Frostpunk
notes: 2018, 11 bit studios; Hope and Discontent meters; Book of Laws with sequenced laws and escalating compromises; revolt ends the game when hope is too low or discontent too high for too long.

name: Frostpunk 2
notes: 2024, 11 bit studios; council of 100 faction-affiliated members votes on laws; 51 votes for most laws, two thirds for laws granting the Steward more power; negotiation by promises; faction tension can reach civil war.

name: FTL: Faster Than Light
notes: Eight procedurally generated sectors of about twenty beacons with events and choices; rebel fleet advances with each jump; save deleted when the ship is destroyed or crew lost; Subset Games, 2012-09-14.

name: Game Dev Tycoon
notes: Greenheart Games, 2012-12-10; Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, Android, Switch 2020. Garage start in the 1980s, engines, console licenses, offices, staff, R&D and Hardware labs; JavaScript gdt-modAPI mods; inspired by Game Dev Story; piracy stunt with in-game bankruptcy.

name: Garry's Mod
notes: Facepunch Studios, Garry Newman; Source engine mod released 2004-12-24; standalone on Steam 2006-11-29 (Valve); Windows, macOS, Linux; physics gun, tool gun welds and constraints; Lua addons; gamemodes TTT, Prop Hunt, DarkRP, Wiremod; 25.5 million sold by 2024.

name: Gaussian splatting
notes: Training about 35-45 min vs about 48 h for Mip-NeRF 360; higher memory than NeRF; peak training memory over 20 GB; splotchy and popping artifacts; dynamic (4D) variants.

name: Genie (AI model)
notes: Version history: Genie 2024-03, Genie 2 2024-12 (360p, 10-20 s), Genie 3 2025-08 (720p, 24 fps, one-minute memory); Waymo World Model built on Genie 3 (2026-02) for driving edge cases.

name: Going Medieval
notes: Foxy Voxel, published by Mythwright; early access 2021-06-01, 1.0 2026-03-17; Windows; voxel terrain with cellars and multi-level fortifications; settler traits, skills, perks, needs, and moods; seasons; bandit raids; compared to RimWorld and Dwarf Fortress.

name: Gran Turismo (1997 video game)
notes: Polys Entertainment (Polyphony Digital from 1998), Sony; PlayStation, Japan 1997-12-23; license tests gate Simulation mode events; credits buy cars, parts, tuning; 140 cars, 11 tracks; first DualShock-designed game; 10.85 million sold; IGN: grandfather of modern console racing sims.

name: Hamurabi (video game)
notes: Doug Dyment, 1968, FOCAL on PDP-8; each round is a year: adviser report, then grain for land at 17-26 bushels per acre, seed, and food; random harvest, rats, immigration, plague halving population; game ends if 45% starve in a round; 10 rounds.

name: Hardspace: Shipbreaker
notes: Blackbird Interactive; laser cutter, tether, scanner; cutting electrical wires or coolant pipes can explode; decompression; reactor meltdown timer; debt of $1.2 billion; early access 2020-06-16, full release 2022-05-24.

name: Harvest Moon (video game)
notes: Developer Amccus (Pack-In-Soft team of 8-10), Super Famicom Japan 1996-08-09 as Bokujo Monogatari; daily watering, livestock care rules, bar open after dark, wife added as a goal; director Yasuhiro Wada's three principles.

name: Hearts of Iron IV
notes: Paradox Development Studio, Paradox Interactive, 2016-06-06; Windows, macOS, Linux. Start dates 1936-01-01 and 1939-08-14. National focus trees (initially unique for Germany, UK, USSR, US); civilian and military factories and dockyards; political power for laws and ministers; four ideologies; supply affects combat; weather in sea and air regions; world tension 0 to 100; tank, ship, and plane designers added by DLC.

name: House Flipper
notes: Empyrean; Frozen District and PlayWay; 2018-05-17 PC, PS4/Xbox One 2020-02, Switch 2020-06; painting, tiling, cleaning, demolition, furnishing; email jobs paid by size and quality; buyers with different needs bid at auction; Garden Flipper DLC scores gardens to raise sale price.

name: Infinite Craft
notes: Neal Agarwal (neal.fun); web 2024-01-31, iOS April 2024, Android 2024-05-21; starts from water, fire, wind, earth; pair looked up in a database, new pairs generated by Llama 2 and Llama 3.1 with emoji and stored so all players get the same result; First Discovery label; twenty-token cap.

name: inZOI
notes: inZOI Studio, Krafton; Windows early access 2025-03-28, macOS 2025-08-20, PS5 delayed to early 2027; eight needs, karma system, cities Dowon, Bliss Bay, Kucingku; official mod support added May 2025.

name: iRacing
notes: Released 2008-08-26; Dave Kaemmer and John W. Henry; built from NASCAR Racing 2003 Season code with new tire model; LIDAR-scanned cars and tracks; subscription; Rookie to A licenses; no-blame Safety Rating; Elo-style iRating; 13-week seasons with weekly track rotation; eNASCAR iRacing Series.

name: Islanders (video game)
notes: Grizzly Games (Coatsink from 2022); Windows 2019-04-04; Switch, PS4, Xbox One 2021; Meta Quest 2023; buildings score points from proximity to compatible structures and lose points for incompatible ones; placements are permanent; point thresholds offer a choice of two building packs; filling the gauge unlocks a new island; no resources, traffic, or research; global leaderboard only.

name: Job Simulator
notes: Owlchemy Labs; Windows 2016-04-05 (HTC Vive launch), PS4 2016-10-13, Quest 2019, PS5 2023, visionOS 2024; museum of jobs run by job bots; Office Worker, Gourmet Chef, Store Clerk, Auto Mechanic; most objects can be picked up; over 1 million sold.

name: Jurassic World Evolution
notes: Frontier Developments, 2018-06-12 PC/PS4/Xbox One, Switch 2020. Fossil expeditions, DNA sequencing and genome modification, feeding and social needs, Science/Security/Entertainment divisions with contracts and sabotage, storms, power failures, breakouts, ACU and rangers, five-island career.

name: Kenshi (video game)
notes: Lo-Fi Games; Chris Hunt worked alone until 2013; one of the first Steam Early Access games in March 2013; full release 2018-12-06; Windows; limbs damaged or severed and replaced with prosthetics; skills level through actions; world states react to deaths of notable figures.

name: Kerbal Space Program
notes: Squad (Mexico); first public release 0.7.3 on 2011-06-24; Steam early access 2013-03-20; 1.0 on 2015-04-27; Linux, macOS, Windows, PS4/PS5, Xbox; patched-conic orbits (no n-body); sandbox, science, and career modes with funds, reputation, contracts; joint strength limits; 3,000+ mods.

name: Kingdoms and Castles
notes: Lion Shield; Linux, macOS, Windows 2017-07-20; Xbox 2023-12-01; PlayStation 2024-03-21; peasants farm, build, cut lumber; taxes; dragons, vikings, and ogres attack; annual winter destroys crops, lightning fires, plagues; diplomats, alliances, trade, war with AI kingdoms.

name: Left 4 Dead
notes: The AI Director places infected and items based on each player's situation, status, skill, and location, uses music and effects to build tension; Valve calls it procedural narrative; released 2008-11-18.

name: Lemonade Stand
notes: 1973 MECC (Bob Jamison, attribution flagged), Apple II port 1979; daily inputs are glasses made, signs, and price per glass; weather report; storms void profits; 12 days.

name: Little Computer People
notes: Designers Rich Gold and David Crane, Activision; C64 release 1985-09-27 and later ports; six-hour real-time day, 256 names, typed commands, no win condition; Will Wright played it.

name: Manor Lords
notes: Slavic Magic (Greg Styczen), Hooded Horse; Windows early access 2024-04-26, still early access with Major Update 8 in August 2026; curved roads and gridless housing; six tax types, yearly King's tax, tithes; soil exhaustion and deforestation; retinue, mercenaries, armed villagers; bandits; AI lords; over 4 million copies by August 2026.

name: Microsoft Flight Simulator (2020 video game)
notes: Asobo Studio, Xbox Game Studios; Windows 2020-08-18, VR 2020-12-22, Xbox Series 2021-07-27; Bing Maps terrain updated every 28 days; Azure AI 3D generation streamed from cloud, over two petabytes; Meteoblue live weather; live air traffic; physics simulates over 1,000 control surfaces and wind over terrain; legacy flight model option; marketplace.

name: Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024
notes: Asobo Studio, Xbox Game Studios; Windows and Xbox Series 2024-11-19, PS5 2025-12-08, PS VR2 2026-04; career mode with experience, reputation, certifications; firefighting, search and rescue, crop dusting, cargo hook, Beluga, A400M, airline jobs; walk-around preflight; revised systems; 3D ground surfaces; server problems at launch.

name: Mindustry
notes: Developed by Anuke; created for the April 2017 itch.io Metal Monstrosity game jam; GPL-3.0; Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iOS; on Steam from 2019; v6 (2020) added RTS elements and logic blocks; v7 (2022) added Erekir; co-op, team PvP, free-for-all, and attack maps; 18 Serpulo and 10 Erekir turrets; 35 and 15 units.

name: Minecraft
notes: Mojang Studios, Markus Persson; first public alpha 2009-05-17; full release 2011-11-18; PC, consoles, mobile; procedural voxel world with biomes; survival mode with health and hunger; 20-minute day-night cycle with night mobs; redstone logic; villager trading; influences Infiniminer, Dwarf Fortress, RollerCoaster Tycoon; 400 million+ sold.

name: Mini Metro (video game)
notes: Ludum Dare 26 prototype April 2013 with free web version; alpha September 2013; Steam Early Access August 2014; PC 1.0 2015-11-06; mobile 2016, Switch 2018, PS4 2019. Stations overcrowd at about six passengers; weekly asset rewards; Normal, Extreme, Endless, Creative modes.

name: Monte Carlo tree search
notes: History (Coulom 2006 naming, Kocsis and Szepesvari 2006 UCT); lists Total War: Rome II high-level campaign AI (citing AiGameDev coverage archived 2017) and Fable Legends real-time tactical planning (2015 nucl.ai talk) as video game uses.

name: Motorsport Manager
notes: Playsport Games; mobile original iOS 2014 and Android 2015; desktop version November 2016 for macOS, Windows, Linux, published by Sega.

name: M.U.L.E.
notes: 1983, Ozark Softscape, Danielle Bunten Berry; real-time auctions; ties go to the trailing player; withholding supply raises later prices; land auctions replaced by a free plot per turn because of a feedback loop.

name: MuZero
notes: Training compute (board games: 16 TPUs training, 1000 for self-play, 800 simulations per step; Atari: 8 and 32 TPUs, 50 simulations); matched AlphaZero in Go after about 1M steps; poor on 6 Atari games; successors EfficientZero and Stochastic MuZero.

name: Nintendogs
notes: Nintendo EAD, DS; Japan release 2005-04-21; touch care, microphone tricks, disc, agility, and obedience trials with five classes, DS clock-driven hunger and dirt, dogs cannot die, three dogs at home, Bark Mode.

name: Noita (video game)
notes: Nolla Games; early access 2019-09-24; 1.0 on 2020-10-15; Windows; Falling Everything engine simulates every pixel; liquids, gases, solids react; Box2D rigid bodies; wand and spell crafting; permadeath roguelite; influences The Powder Toy, Liero, roguelikes.

name: Offworld Trading Company
notes: 2016, Mohawk Games; constantly fluctuating supply and demand; victory by majority stakes in every company; elimination on losing control; buyout warnings; black market.

name: Opus Magnum
notes: Zachtronics, early access 2017-10-19, full release 2017-12-08; players ranked on cycles, cost, and area; the community uses an unofficial combined 'sum' metric.

name: The Oregon Trail (1971 video game)
notes: Rawitsch, Heinemann, and Dillenberger, 3 December 1971; about 12 rounds of two weeks; per-round food consumption choice and typed hunting; one or two random events and weather per round; starvation, cold, or untreated illness kill.

name: The Oregon Trail (1985 video game)
notes: MECC, Apple II, autumn 1985; design led by R. Philip Bouchard; adjustable pace and rations; ford, caulk, or ferry river crossings; hunting with a 100-pound carry limit; party of five; banker, carpenter, or farmer; high scores and tombstones.

name: Out of the Park Baseball
notes: Out of the Park Developments, Markus Heinsohn, first release May 1999 for Windows 98; text play-by-play, 3D ballpark from OOTP 15, scouting recode OOTP 14, trade AI, finances OOTP 16, MLB license OOTP 16, historical leagues and debuts, HTML reports.

name: Oxygen Not Included
notes: Klei Entertainment; Steam early access 2017-02-15, full release 2019-07-30; Windows, macOS, Linux; gases diffuse and equalize, liquids drain under gravity; prioritized tasks, duplicants favor tasks they are best at; names Dwarf Fortress, Prison Architect, and The Sims as influences; Automation Innovation and Spaced Out updates.

name: Papers, Please
notes: Daily entry rules that grow over time; tools include interrogation, fingerprinting, and body scans; citations for protocol violations cut daily earnings; wages must cover rent, food, and heat; fixed real-time shift; 3909 LLC, Lucas Pope, 2013-08-08.

name: Paralives
notes: Paralives Studio, designer Alex Massé; Steam early access 2026-05-25 for Windows and macOS; Patreon funding; road-style building tool inspired by Cities: Skylines; together bar and together cards; procedural animation.

name: Patched conic approximation
notes: Spheres of influence reduce n-body motion to two-body conics joined at boundaries by matching position and velocity; does not model Lagrange points; lists Kerbal Space Program as a spaceflight simulator based on it.

name: PC Building Simulator
notes: Claudiu Kiss and The Irregular Corporation; early access 2018-03-27, full release 2019-01-29; Windows, PS4, Xbox One, Switch; email jobs (virus removal, upgrades, fixes, overclocking, builds); licensed parts with shipping tiers; 3DMark benchmarking; cooler without thermal paste overheats; monthly rent and electricity or debt.

name: Permadeath
notes: Definition; Rogue deleted the save file on load; save scumming; optional hardcore modes; Richard Bartle's arguments for and against permadeath in virtual worlds; most MMORPGs avoid it.

name: Pharaoh (video game)
notes: Impressions Games, Sierra Studios; Windows, North America 1999-11-02; same engine and principles as Caesar III; floodplain farms by the Nile, irrigation ditches raise fertility, Osiris can improve or worsen the flood; monuments need worker facilities and materials; five gods (Ra, Bast, Osiris, Ptah, Seth); housing levels from goods, services, surroundings; Cleopatra expansion 2000; remake A New Era 2023.

name: Plague Inc.
notes: Ndemic Creations, iOS release 26 May 2012; player evolves a pathogen to infect and kill humanity before a cure is developed; creator James Vaughan invited to speak at the CDC in March 2013; Ndemic later stated the game is not on par with scientific models.

name: Planet Coaster
notes: Frontier Developments; alpha 2016-03-22; Windows release 2016-11-17; Console Edition 2020. Hybrid spline and piece coaster builder, modular structures, voxel terrain, Career/Challenge/Sandbox, Steam Workshop and Frontier Workshop; spiritual successor to RollerCoaster Tycoon 3.

name: Planet Zoo
notes: Frontier Developments, Windows 2019-11-05, consoles 2024. Species-specific welfare, mixed habitats, genomes affecting lifespan, size, health, fertility; inbreeding; conservation rating; franchise mode online animal market; spiritual successor to Zoo Tycoon.

name: Poly Bridge
notes: Dry Cactus; Steam early access 2015; full release 2016 (article body 12 June, infobox 12 July); materials steel, wood, rope, cable, hydraulics; sequels Poly Bridge 2 (2020) and 3 (2023); series sold 6 million+.

name: Populous (video game)
notes: Bullfrog, designed by Peter Molyneux, Amiga March 1989; raising and lowering land is the basic power; mana comes from followers building houses; more mana unlocks earthquakes, floods, swamps, volcanoes, and knights.

name: PowerWash Simulator
notes: FuturLab; early access 2021-05-19, full release 2022-07-14; four nozzles with different power and width; dirt, grime, lichen, moss, rust; surface-specific soaps; progress bars per object and level; highlight for remaining dirt; upgrades.

name: Princess Maker 2
notes: Gainax, designers Takami Akai and Masato Kato; PC-98 release 1993-06-15 and many ports; ages 10 to 18, three periods per month, training, jobs, adventure, free time, annual income, October festivals, rival girls, 74 endings.

name: Prison Architect
notes: Introversion Software; prisoner needs; reform and labour programs reduce recidivism; grading on recidivism, happiness, and violence; full release 2015-10-06.

name: Project Genie (website)
notes: Launched 2026-01-29 for Google AI Ultra subscribers 18+; 60-second limit; Street View integration reported 2026-05-19; video game stocks including Unity fell after launch (citing Bloomberg).

name: Project Hospital
notes: Oxymoron Games (Czech), 2018-10-30, Windows/macOS/Linux; build and run a hospital with accurate medical procedures; DLCs: Doctor Mode (2019, control individual doctors), Hospital Services (2020, staff training, cafeterias), Infectious Diseases (2020), Traumatology (2020).

name: Project Zomboid
notes: The Indie Stone; paid tech demo 2011-05-28; Steam early access 2013; still in early access; Build 41 2021-12-20, Build 42 open beta 2024-12-17; Windows, macOS, Linux; Java; skills from activities and books; infection always fatal; water and power shut off within a month; seasons and climate.

name: Railroad Tycoon (video game)
notes: 1990, Sid Meier and Bruce Shelley, MicroProse; $1 million start split between equity and a loan; bonds; miniature stock market; rival barons using stock dealings and rate wars.

name: Rebel Inc. (video game)
notes: Ndemic Creations, designer James Vaughan. iOS 2018-12-08, Android 2019-02-11, Windows and macOS as Rebel Inc: Escalation 2019-10-15. Stabilize a war-torn region against an insurgency; monthly budget for civilian initiatives and military spending; more initiatives raise corruption and inflation; governance tab; negotiated peace; governors such as the Economist and Warlord; regions inspired by Afghanistan; described as a spiritual sequel to Plague Inc.

name: Reigns (video game)
notes: Swipe-left-or-right cards from advisors; four meters (church, people, army, treasury); the reign ends when any meter is full or empty; successors continue with unlocked cards; Nerial, Devolver Digital, August 2016; inspired by Tinder.

name: RimWorld
notes: Release history (public alpha 2013-11-04, 1.0 2018-10-17), developer, platforms, storyteller description.

name: RollerCoaster Tycoon (video game)
notes: Designed and programmed by Chris Sawyer; released 1999-03-22 in North America; 21 base scenarios, each completion unlocks the next; expansions add 30 each.

name: RollerCoaster Tycoon
notes: Series article: rides rated on excitement, intensity, and nausea; guests have preferred intensity, nausea tolerance, thoughts, and needs; research unlocks rides; park rating goals; OpenRCT2; Planet Coaster called a spiritual successor to RCT3.

name: Satisfactory
notes: Coffee Stain Studios, published by Coffee Stain Publishing; early access 2019-03-19; 1.0 on PC 2024-09-10; PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S 2025-11-04; single-player and co-op; FICSIT tiers completed by delivering crafted components; Space Elevator receives Project Assembly parts; 5.5 million copies by January 2024.

name: Schedule I (video game)
notes: TVGS, Unity, Windows, early access 2025-03-24; first-person crime business sim in Hyland Point; ingredient mixing raises sale value; police searches, curfews, wanted status; dealers, cooks, janitors, botanists; properties and fronts; Benzies cartel truce quota.

name: Seaman (video game)
notes: Vivarium, designer Yoot Saito; Dreamcast Japan 1999-07-29, NA 2000-08-08, PS2 Japan 2001; microphone conversation, tank heat, water, and food, daily check-ins, five life stages, Leonard Nimoy narration.

name: Second Life
notes: Linden Lab, public launch 2003-06-23; viewers for Windows, macOS, Linux. Described as a platform with no set objective. Prims (linked sets up to 256) and imported mesh; Linden Scripting Language runs server-side; Havok physics; regions 256 by 256 m on a dedicated core, 40 avatars on mainland and 100 on private islands; users keep copyright; Linden Dollar and LindeX exchange; Marketplace about 2.1 million items; peak concurrency 88,200 in 2009.

name: Shapez 2
notes: tobspr Games (Germany), Unity engine; Gamera Games publishes in China and Japan; early access 2024-08-15; 1.0 on 2026-04-23; update 1.1 on 2026-06-25; Windows, macOS, Linux; shapes of up to four layers of four quadrants; buildings are free and there are no victory conditions; procedurally generated world; sequel to Shapez (2020).

name: Sid Meier
notes: States that Meier created Railroad Tycoon inspired by SimCity and Empire, and that it led to Civilization.

name: Silent Hunter III
notes: Ubisoft Bucharest, Ubisoft; Windows 2005-03-15; dynamic campaign generates convoys, escorts, task forces in patrol grids; crew rank, experience, morale, decorations persist; manual targeting of class, nationality, speed, angle on the bow, gyro angle or automatic Weapons Officer; career from Lieutenant Jr., bases 1939-1943; Metacritic 90.

name: SimAnt
notes: Maxis 1991, Will Wright and Justin McCormick; based on Holldobler and Wilson's The Ants; yellow player ant, swap by double-click; trails to food and enemies; recruiting followers; worker, soldier, queen, and drone castes; hazards including rain, lawnmowers, spiders, antlions; Quick, Full, and Experimental games; SNES 1993.

name: SimCity (1989 video game)
notes: Released February 1989; goal-oriented, time-limited scenarios ending in win or loss, added at Broderbund's suggestion to make it more like a traditional game; disasters including floods, tornadoes, fires, earthquakes, and monsters; Super NES version adds advisor Dr. Wright who reports city problems.

name: SimCity 2000
notes: 1993, Maxis, Will Wright and Fred Haslam; city ordinances; bonds; separate residential, commercial, industrial tax rates; extreme deficit spending ends the game.

name: SimCity (2013 video game)
notes: Region play: cities share highways, rail, and waterways, trade resources, share services, see traffic and pollution cross borders, and pool wealth into Great Works; asynchronous always-online connection; launch outages and save problems; offline mode in a later update.

name: SimCity 4
notes: Maxis, EA; Windows 2003-01-14, Mac OS X 2003-06-27; Rush Hour expansion 2003-09-22; regions of cities 1-4 km per side with neighbor deals for water, power, and garbage; God, Mayor, and MySim modes; zone densities, agriculture zone, wealth levels, decay and gentrification; per-building service funding, aging facilities; Rush Hour traffic tracing; Jeff Speck on the traffic model; Building Architect Tool (2004).

name: SimEarth
notes: Maxis, 1990, designed by Will Wright and Fred Haslam; James Lovelock advised and his Gaia hypothesis shaped the models; atmospheric gas percentages, warming melts ice caps and raises seas, volcanic dust cools; Daisyworld mode; Mars and Venus terraforming scenarios; actions cost energy.

name: SimLife
notes: Maxis 1992 (Amiga 1993), designed by Ken Karakotsios; players modify plant and animal genetics, design environments and ecosystems, change the world's physics, and control evolution; exclusive species Killer Penguin, Monkeyphant, Orgot; 1993 Codie award.

name: SimTower
notes: OPeNBooK, designer Yoot Saito; released 1994 (Japan as The Tower; Maxis published elsewhere); Windows, Mac, Saturn, 3DO; offices, condos, hotels, restaurants, shops; standard elevators span up to 30 floors, express full height; 100 floors above ground, 9 below; tenant stress; star ratings 1-5 then Tower (cathedral); terrorist bomb ransom, VIP visits, fires, pests.

name: SnowRunner
notes: Saber Interactive, Focus Home Interactive; Windows/PS4/Xbox One 2020-04-28, Switch 2021, PS5/Xbox Series 2022, Switch 2 2026; cargo delivery and construction or repair jobs; physical and UI damage; tire types and frame attachments; upgrades gated by progress; over 60 vehicles; MudRunner physics engine by Pavel Zagrebelnyy.

name: Space Engineers
notes: Keen Software House (Czech); alpha 2013-10-23 on Steam early access; full release 2019-02-28; Xbox One 2020, PS4/PS5 2023; VRAGE engine; editable voxel asteroids and planets; small and large grids; deformable armor blocks; conveyors; inertia dampeners; oxygen and energy survival; 5 million+ sold.

name: Space Haven
notes: Bugbyte; early access 2020, 1.0 2026-05-13; Windows, macOS, Linux; ship parts built from mined or salvaged resources; oxygen and heat life support; crew characteristics, relationships, and faction leaders added in 2022.

name: SpaceChem
notes: Released 2011-01-01 by Zachtronics; solutions ranked on instructions, cycles, and reactors; Zach Barth designed global histograms so players could check solutions without being overwhelmed by top players on a leaderboard.

name: Spore (2008 video game)
notes: Creations auto-uploaded to the Sporepedia, ranked by downloads, and redistributed into other players' galaxies; a few kilobytes per item thanks to procedural reconstruction; content filters and in-game bans; over 100 million creations by May 2009; released September 2008.

name: Stardew Valley
notes: ConcernedApe (Eric Barone), Windows release 2016-02-26, later consoles, handhelds, and mobile; energy bar, four 28-day seasons, crops, animals, mines, five skills, 12 marriage candidates, Community Center bundles, co-op multiplayer 2018, Harvest Moon inspiration.

name: Starfire
notes: Article on Stephen V. Cole's 1979 Starfire board wargame, reached through the Aurora (video game) redirect. States that Aurora, described as a 4X Dwarf Fortress in space, was originally based on an assistant program for Starfire, citing a Rock, Paper, Shotgun interview of 2013-11-21.

name: Stellaris (video game)
notes: Paradox Development Studio, Paradox Interactive. PC 2016-05-09; PS4 and Xbox One 2019-02-26. Procedural galaxies linked by hyperlanes; start 2200, default 300-year campaign, highest score wins. Pops in worker, specialist, and ruler strata fill jobs from districts and buildings; eight ethics on four axes; factions produce unity; galactic crises. Fahraeus named Star Control II, Master of Orion II, and EU4 as influences.

name: Subnautica
notes: Unknown Worlds Entertainment; Steam early access 2014-12-16, full release 2018-01-23; consoles 2018, Switch 2021, mobile 2025; health, hunger, thirst, and oxygen in Survival; Freedom, Hardcore, and Creative modes; blueprints, crafting, bases, submersibles; day-night cycle with eclipses; story on planet 4546B.

name: Surgeon Simulator
notes: Bossa Studios; made in 48 hours at Global Game Jam 2013, Steam release 2013-04-19; mouse moves hand, A/W/E/R/Space control fingers; patient Bob; heart rate reaching 0 requires defibrillators; iPad 2014, PS4 2014, Switch 2018 with local co-op; controls inspired by Jurassic Park: Trespasser; 2 million sold by 2015.

name: Surviving Mars
notes: Haemimont Games (Abstraction Games from 2021), Paradox Interactive; 2018-03-15; Windows, macOS, Linux, PS4, Xbox One; domes need power, water, oxygen; colonists with traits, flaws, specializations; morale, comfort, sanity, health; five-field tech tree; Mysteries; sponsors; dust storms, meteors, cold waves, dust devils; Green Planet terraforming 2019; Relaunched 2025-11-10.

name: Suzerain (video game)
notes: Torpor Games (Berlin). Windows and macOS 2020-12-04; Switch 2021-09-23; Android and iOS 2022-12-08; PlayStation and Xbox 2025-11-11. Player is President Anton Rayne of Sordland for one term; multiple-choice dialogue with ministers and advisers; constitutional, economic, security, and welfare decisions; budget statistics; western, eastern, or neutral alignment; several endings with a political-compass result; about 450,000 words.

name: Tamagotchi
notes: Bandai with WiZ, creators Aki Maita and Akihiro Yokoi; Japan release 1996-11-23; Hunger, Happy, and Training meters, life stages, care-dependent adult form, droppings and sickness, death; about 40 million units in the first run.

name: Teardown (video game)
notes: Tuxedo Labs (Dennis Gustafsson); early access 2020-10-29; full release 2022-04-21; PS5 and Xbox Series 2023; fully destructible voxel levels; alarm starts 60-second getaway timer; fire spread; ray-traced lighting; Lua scripting and Workshop; co-op multiplayer update 2026-03-12.

name: Technology tree
notes: Tech tree as a directed acyclic graph with tiers; Francis Tresham's 1980 board game Civilization generally credited with introducing it; Sid Meier's Civilization (1991); simple versus complex trees; repeatable future tech in Civilization.

name: Terra Nil
notes: Free Lives, published by Devolver Digital; Windows, Android, iOS 2023-03-28 (mobile via Netflix Games), Linux and macOS 2023-10, Switch 2023-12; began as a Ludum Dare 45 entry (October 2019); turbines on stone power toxin scrubbers; pumps refill rivers; points per restored tile; biomes attract animals; recycle buildings and leave.

name: The Incredible Machine
notes: Series from 1993; designed and coded by Kevin Ryan, produced by Jeff Tunnell (Jeff Tunnell Productions), published by Dynamix/Sierra; MS-DOS, 3DO, later Windows and Mac; Rube Goldberg puzzles with fixed objects and provided parts; deterministic engine simulating gravity and air pressure; freeform mode; Contraption Maker successor.

name: The Long Dark
notes: Hinterland, full release 1 August 2017; player manages body temperature, calories, hunger, weight, fatigue, illness, and injury; fire for warmth and cooking; day-night cycle with colder nights; story, survival, and challenge modes.

name: The Powder Toy
notes: Falling-sand game first released 2008 by Stanislaw Skowronek; maintained by GitHub contributors under GPLv3; Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, Steam (2024); 258 elements as of February 2025; online save sharing with votes; Lua scripting.

name: The Sims (video game)
notes: Maxis, Windows release 2000-02-04, later Mac, Linux, PS2, GameCube, Xbox; free will, 20,000 simoleon start, 150+ objects, death by neglect; A Pattern Language influence; sales and MoMA acquisition.

name: The Sims 2
notes: Maxis Redwood Shores, Windows release 2004-09-14 plus console, handheld, and Java ME versions; seven life stages with day counts, genetics, 25 personality points, eight aspirations, wants and fears, memories, careers with ten levels.

name: The Sims 3
notes: Infobox credits Maxis Redwood Shores; Windows and Mac release 2009-06-02, later consoles, DS, 3DS, mobile; seamless open world, Story Progression, up to five traits, wishes, Lifetime Happiness, 12 careers, opportunities.

name: The Sims 4
notes: Maxis, Windows release 2014-09-02, macOS 2015, PS4 and Xbox One 2017, free to play 2022-10-18; emotions, three traits plus aspiration trait, multitasking, Gallery, room-based build mode, life stages, CurseForge partnership.

name: Theme Hospital
notes: 1997, Bullfrog; hire doctors, nurses, handymen, receptionists with performance statistics; training; specialist skills gate rooms; rest; dismissal over pay disputes; loans via policy setting.

name: Theme Park (video game)
notes: Bullfrog Productions, Peter Molyneux and Demis Hassabis, EA, MS-DOS June 1994, many ports incl. DS and iOS. Per-visitor personalities, ingredient tuning, research funding, staff, wage and supply negotiations, thugs, yearly judging against rivals, sell park and buy plots worldwide.

name: This War of Mine
notes: 11 bit studios; Windows, OS X, Linux 2014-11-14, later mobile and consoles; daytime shelter crafting, trading, and care, night scavenging; hunger, health, and mood until a randomized ceasefire; one or two traits per survivor; moral choices affect endings; radio reports; inspired by the Siege of Sarajevo.

name: Timberborn
notes: Mechanistry; early access 2021-09-15; 1.0 on 2026-03-12; macOS, Windows; Folktails and Iron Teeth factions; water simulated in 2D, replaced by 3D water in Update 6 (October 2024); droughts lower water; badtides release badwater cured by Antidote; dams; irrigation rework; bots; water wheels; official mod support in Update 6.

name: Tiny Glade
notes: Pounce Light (Anastasia Opara, Tomasz Stachowiak); self-published 2024-09-23 for Windows and Linux; macOS 2026-05-13; medieval building sandbox with no tasks or unlocks; terrain height, time of day, rivers and ponds; custom fork of the Rust engine Bevy.

name: Tomodachi Life
notes: Nintendo SPD, 3DS; Japan 2013-04-18, NA and EU 2014-06-06; apartment of up to 100 Miis, autonomous friendships and conflicts, player-approved confessions, marriage and children, StreetPass, problems and happiness levels; sequel 2026-04-16.

name: Townscaper
notes: Oskar Stalberg; full release Windows, macOS, Switch 2021-08-26; iOS and Android 2021-10-20; Xbox 2021-12-01; place and remove colored blocks on a large distorted grid in an infinite sea; rule-based decoration by location and surroundings; no objective, described by its author as more of a toy.

name: Transport Tycoon
notes: MS-DOS November 1994, Chris Sawyer, MicroProse; Deluxe 1995; ports to PlayStation, Saturn, Android, iOS. Road, rail, sea, air; reliability and breakdowns; station catchment and ratings; delivery-time revenue; Local Authority ratings; up to seven AI rivals; influences Railroad Tycoon, A-Train, SimCity 2000, Theme Park; OpenTTD.

name: Tropico 6
notes: Limbic Entertainment, Kalypso Media; Windows, macOS, Linux 2019-03-29; PS4 and Xbox One 2019-09-27; Switch 2020-11-06; PS5 and Xbox Series 2022; four eras (Colonial, World Wars, Cold War, Modern); archipelago with bridges from the World Wars era; fully simulated citizens whose treatment affects productivity and revolt; raids; multiplayer.

name: Turns, rounds and time-keeping systems in games
notes: Taxonomy: turn-based, simultaneous (decision then execution phases, e.g. Diplomacy, Combat Mission), phased turns (Agricola harvest phases, Imperium Romanum II taxation every third turn), real-time, pausable real-time (Baldur's Gate, Paradox games, SimCity, RollerCoaster Tycoon), time compression (flight simulators), action points.

name: Two Point Hospital
notes: Two Point Studios, Sega, PC 2018-08-30, consoles 2020. Staff traits and qualifications, assistants run marketing, room prestige, epidemics with limited vaccines, Kudosh unlocks, star ratings, async challenges, Steam Workshop 2019; spiritual successor to Theme Hospital.

name: Ultima Online
notes: Origin Systems, Electronic Arts, 1997-09-24; lead designer Raph Koster. Skill-based progression with no levels or classes; persistent player housing; craft-based player-driven economy; unrestricted PvP at launch; Trammel/Felucca split with Renaissance (2000); item insurance (2003); planned artificial-life ecology removed in beta because players killed creatures faster than they spawned; first MMORPG to reach 100,000 subscribers.

name: Universe Sandbox
notes: Original by Dan Dixon, May 2008, Windows; Universe Sandbox 2 public alpha 2014-08-26, renamed Universe Sandbox in 2018; Giant Army, Seattle; Windows, macOS, Linux; gravity, collisions, surface temperature, composition, Steam Workshop sharing from 2018.

name: Utility system
notes: Utility AI scores candidate actions and picks the best or a weighted random one; The Sims combined needs with object scores; The Sims 3 used a modified Boltzmann distribution whose temperature rises when a Sim is doing poorly (Richard Evans); response curves (Dave Mark); Infinite Axis Utility System (Mark and Lewis, GDC 2015).

name: Utopia (1981 video game)
notes: Infobox and lead date the Intellivision release to 1982-06-03 (Aquarius port 1983) although the article title says 1981; Mattel Electronics, designed and programmed by Don Daglow; two players, up to 50 rounds of 30-120 s; gold buys houses, schools, factories, hospitals, forts, fishing and PT boats; income from factories, fishing boats over fish schools, and rain clouds over farms; rebels; hurricanes and tropical storms; pirates.

name: Valheim
notes: Iron Gate Studio, published by Coffee Stain; early access 2021-02-02, 1.0 2026-09-09 with PS5 and Switch 2; seeded procedural world of nine biomes; food raises maximum health and stamina; eight bosses summoned at altars; skills to level 100; co-op up to ten players.

name: Victoria 3
notes: Paradox Development Studio, Paradox Interactive, 2022-10-25; Windows, macOS, Linux. Set 1836 to 1936, over 100 playable countries. Interest groups such as the Devout, Industrialists, and Rural Folk with affiliation based on economic status; industrialization by building mines and factories; world market trading; laws such as Free Trade and Laissez-Faire; diplomatic plays with demands, counter-demands, a mobilization countdown, and war if unresolved.

name: Viva Piñata (video game)
notes: Rare; Xbox 360 NA 2006-11-09, Windows port by Climax 2007; 60 species; outline-to-resident attraction requirements; ungendered romance with maze minigame and egg; candy shortcut after first romance; piñatavores must eat other piñatas; sours, ruffians, Professor Pester; trading over Xbox Live.

name: Workers & Resources: Soviet Republic
notes: 3Division, Hooded Horse; early access 2019-03-15; 1.0 on 2024-06-20; Windows; goods need infrastructure, staff, vehicles; customs houses for export; rubles East, dollars West; citizens' health and happiness; optional complex education, utilities, and seasons; Steam Workshop.

name: X-Plane (simulator)
notes: Flight model based on blade element theory: wings, control surfaces, and propellers divided into elements, forces computed per element from aircraft geometry rather than relying solely on performance tables.

name: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
notes: Nintendo EPD; 2017-03-03 on Wii U and Switch; modified Havok physics; chemistry engine defines object properties and interactions; lightning seeks metal; fire, temperature resistance via cooking; weapon durability; stamina for climbing and gliding; 35.76 million sold by June 2026.

name: Zoo Tycoon (2001 video game)
notes: Blue Fang Games, Microsoft, 2001-10-17 Windows and Mac; DS 2005. Exhibit suitability from terrain, foliage, rocks, shelters, toys; guest happiness; predation; decaying fences; staff; scenario and freeform modes; research unlocks.

name: Efficient Guided Generation for Large Language Models
notes: Outlines: recasts generation as transitions of a finite-state machine with a precomputed index from states to allowed vocabulary tokens, constraining output to regular expressions and context-free grammars with little overhead.

name: Marble: A Multimodal World Model
notes: Generally available 2025-11-12; inputs text, images, video, coarse 3D layouts; outputs Gaussian splats, triangle meshes, collider meshes for coarse physics, videos; Chisel blockout plus style prompt; Spark renderer for three.js; artifacts and invented regions noted.

name: RTFM: A Real-Time Frame Model
notes: Research preview; single H100; interactive frame rates; posed frames as spatial memory with context juggling; no explicit 3D; dynamic worlds and interaction listed as future work.

name: Atlas: A World Model for Spatial Intelligence
notes: Omni multimodal autoregressive diffusion transformer over text, images, video, 3D; up to 1 min 1440p camera-controlled video; outputs point clouds and 3D Gaussian splats; early access with partners; will power future Marble versions.

name: World Labs blog and news index
notes: Dated posts: World API 2026-01-21; Spark 2.0 streaming 3DGS LOD 2026-04-14; SceniX acquisition 2026-07-21; Atlas 2026-09-01; World Labs Is Joining AMD 2026-09-28.

name: Friday Facts #88 - Combinators
notes: Introduces arithmetic, decider, and constant combinators on the Factorio circuit network; red and green wire signals entering one entity are summed; stated aims include logic gates, memory cells, timers, lamp progress bars, and routing trains by outpost resource level.

name: Friday Facts #122 - Better Circuit Network I
notes: Factorio 0.13 circuit changes: lamps colored by color signals, roboports reporting logistic contents, requester chests set from signals, more virtual signals; states a design principle of not adding new combinator types such as logic, bit, or timer combinators.

name: Friday Facts #170 - Blueprint library GUI design and redesign
notes: Blueprint library design: personal blueprints persist across saves and are shared with other players in multiplayer; separate save-specific game blueprints; blueprints dragged to the hotbar like items. Described as work in progress.

name: Friday Facts #176 - Belts optimization for 0.15
notes: Adjacent belts merge into transport lines; items are stored as gaps between neighbors so a free-flowing line updates only its end gaps; reported x50-100 speedup of item movement.

name: Friday Facts #317 - New pathfinding algorithm
notes: Biters path with A*; artillery aggro across lakes made long searches slow; hierarchical pathfinding abstracts each 32x32 chunk into terrain components ignoring entities; an abstract Reverse Resumable A* runs from the goal and supplies the heuristic for the tile-level A*; long searches take a few ticks; path behavior unchanged.

name: Friday Facts #375 - Quality
notes: Five quality levels (normal, uncommon +30%, rare +60%, epic +90%, legendary +150%); quality module 1 adds +1% chance; each further step 10x less likely; recycler returns 25% of ingredients; productivity capped at +300%.

name: Friday Facts #384 - Combinators 2.0
notes: Factorio 2.0 circuit changes: new selector combinator (index, count, random, stack size), decider combinator with multiple AND/OR conditions and outputs, per-wire input selection, live signal values in GUIs, combinator descriptions saved in blueprints.

name: Friday Facts #414 - Spoils of Agriculture
notes: Spoil times from about 2 hours to a few minutes; spoiling cannot be delayed; recipe outputs inherit ingredient freshness; spoiled items become Spoilage; inserters can pick freshest or most spoiled first; buffering is not helpful.

name: Friday Facts #416 - Fluids 2.0
notes: 1.x per-pipe flow lost throughput with distance and depended on build order; 2.0 merges pipes into segments, producers push freely, consumers pull proportional to fill ratio, fluid does not propagate.

name: Factorio Lua API documentation
notes: Mods use a modified Lua 5.2 and pass through settings, prototype (data), and runtime (control) stages in a fixed data lifecycle; the runtime stage is event-driven.

name: Outracing champion Gran Turismo drivers with deep reinforcement learning
notes: Sony AI; model-free deep RL with mixed-scenario training and a reward shaped for sportsmanship rules; beat four top Gran Turismo drivers head to head.

name: Car Mechanic Simulator 2021 on Xbox
notes: Xbox One and Xbox Series X|S version; endless generated customer orders; story missions; repair, paint, tune, rebuild; auction house and barns; project car restoration.

name: Structured 3D Latents for Scalable and Versatile 3D Generation
authors: Jianfeng Xiang;Zelong Lv;Sicheng Xu;Yu Deng;Ruicheng Wang;Bowen Zhang;Dong Chen;Xin Tong;Jiaolong Yang
notes: TRELLIS: Structured LATent (sparse voxels with vision-foundation-model features); up to 2B parameters; ~500K 3D objects; decodes to radiance fields, 3D Gaussians, meshes; repo lists MIT license, 16 GB GPU, CVPR'25 spotlight.

name: PhysGaussian: Physics-Integrated 3D Gaussians for Generative Dynamics
authors: Tianyi Xie;Zeshun Zong;Yuxing Qiu;Xuan Li;Yutao Feng;Yin Yang;Chenfanfu Jiang
notes: Custom MPM on Gaussian kernels; elastic, metal, non-Newtonian, granular materials; no meshing; 'what you see is what you simulate'.

name: InterMimic: Towards Universal Whole-Body Control for Physics-Based Human-Object Interactions
authors: Sirui Xu;Hung Yu Ling;Yu-Xiong Wang;Liang-Yan Gui
notes: Teacher policies per subject distilled into one student, refined with RL; trained from hours of imperfect mocap; zero-shot generalization; works with kinematic generators.

name: Mean Field Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
authors: Yaodong Yang;Rui Luo;Minne Li;Ming Zhou;Weinan Zhang;Jun Wang
notes: Each agent learns against the mean action of neighbors instead of all pairwise interactions; mixed cooperative-competitive battle games and Ising model.

name: OASIS: Open Agent Social Interaction Simulations with One Million Agents
notes: Up to one million LLM agents on X- and Reddit-like platforms; replicates information spreading, group polarization, and herd effects; larger agent groups gave stronger group dynamics and more diverse opinions.

name: Mastering Atari Games with Limited Data
authors: Weirui Ye;Shaohuai Liu;Thanard Kurutach;Pieter Abbeel;Yang Gao
notes: EfficientZero: 194.3% mean and 109.0% median human-normalized score on Atari 100k from about two hours of real-time game experience.

name: Affordable Generative Agents
authors: Yangbin Yu;Qin Zhang;Junyou Li;Qiang Fu;Deheng Ye
notes: Lifestyle Policy replays stored plan-action sequences when a new plan matches by embedding cosine >= 0.97 and conditions hold; Social Memory compresses about 2,000 prompt tokens (30-45 events) to about 100. Tokens: 31.1% of baseline (3 agents, two game days), 42.7% (25 agents), 3.4% (VirtualHome, one agent-day); task success differences not significant.

name: MuJoCo Playground
authors: Kevin Zakka;Baruch Tabanpour;Qiayuan Liao;Mustafa Haiderbhai;et al.
notes: MJX-based open-source suite; policies trained in minutes on a single GPU; zero-shot sim-to-real for quadrupeds, humanoids, hands; RSS 2025 outstanding demo paper.

name: Explaining Agent Behavior with Large Language Models
authors: Xijia Zhang;Yue Guo;Simon Stepputtis;Katia Sycara;Joseph Campbell
notes: Learns a compact behavior representation from observed states and actions without model internals, then prompts an LLM to explain; little hallucination; rated about as helpful as a human domain expert; supports follow-up clarification and what-if questions.

name: Winning Isn't Everything: Enhancing Game Development with Intelligent Agents
authors: Yunqi Zhao;Igor Borovikov;Fernando de Mesentier Silva;Ahmad Beirami;Jason Rupert;Caedmon Somers;Jesse Harder;John Kolen;Jervis Pinto;Reza Pourabolghasem;James Pestrak;Harold Chaput;Mohsen Sardari;Long Lin;Sundeep Narravula;Navid Aghdaie;Kazi Zaman
notes: Electronic Arts; case studies include The Sims Mobile career balancing with A* and evolution strategies; deep RL needed heavy tuning per target game, so effort scaled roughly linearly with the number of games.

name: CALYPSO: LLMs as Dungeon Masters' Assistants
authors: Andrew Zhu;Lara J. Martin;Andrew Head;Chris Callison-Burch
notes: LLM interfaces giving D&D Dungeon Masters game-specific information and inspiration; DMs used some text almost directly and developed rougher ideas while keeping creative control.
